It's also worth noting that the act of fasting during Lent can be a powerful tool for self-reflection and personal growth. By temporarily abstaining from certain comforts or pleasures, you may become more aware of your own needs and desires, as well as the needs and struggles of others. This can lead to a greater sense of gratitude, humility, and compassion. Overall, going through the same experiences every year can indeed change how someone thinks about what they owe others.
